newsitem.title: INDIA: India's TELCO 96/97 6-mth net up 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's TELCO 96/97 6-mth net up 46 pct.

text.p: Note: Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO) is India's biggest truck maker. It said exports in the first half rose to 2,416.3 million rupees against 2,475.7 million in the same period a year ago.
Vehicle production rose to 103,883 units against 82,428. Domestic sales went up to 93,320 units against 74,555 while exports dropped to 5,941 against 6,705, the company said.
The firm said its share capital rose to 2,558.6 rupees against 1,417.6 million. It had issued global depositary receipts totalling $200 million.

"Firm demand for the company's product range continues. Any significant slowdown in economic activity or a reversal of the recent easing in interest rates and liquidity however could impact demand levels in the automotive sector," chairman Ratan Tata said in a statement.
